title: Gorillas
medium: Found street posters from New York City, sliced and woven.

said.q: Galen Gibson-Cornell’s Gorillas is a bold, layered exploration of urban imagery, woven from found street posters in New York City. Through his signature process of slicing and interlacing, Gibson-Cornell distorts and reconfigures the original visuals, creating a dynamic surface where fragments of text, color, and form collide.
